<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/v1/service-accounts/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

</MethodEndpoint>



Replaces the display metadata and status. A move to active, including a resume from suspended, succeeds only for an account that holds at least one binding to an enabled trust; otherwise it is refused with 409, whose message names what is missing: no bindings, or only bindings to disabled trusts. If-Match is checked before readiness. Status deprovisioned is reached only through DELETE.
